```{python}
#| label: fig-check-admittance-frequency
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The sampled check follows the analytic error of the series RC example. Passing at 1 MHz does not cover 1 GHz. DC passes because both networks are open there."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.7
#| fig-format: svg
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

project = Path(os.environ['QUARTO_PROJECT_ROOT'])
record = json.loads((project / 'data/checks/admittance-sweep.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
f = np.geomspace(1e6, 1e9, 301)
error = 2*np.pi*f*record['resistance_ohm']*record['capacitance_f']
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.7), layout='constrained')
ax.loglog(f, 100*error, color='#377eb8', label=r'Analytic: $2\pi fRC$')
for passed, color, label in [(True, '#267b39', 'Passing samples'), (False, '#b92f35', 'Failing samples')]:
    points = [p for p in record['samples'] if p['frequency_hz'] > 0 and p['passed'] == passed]
    ax.scatter([p['frequency_hz'] for p in points], [100*p['relative_error'] for p in points],
               color=color, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.7, s=52, zorder=3, label=label)
ax.axhline(1, color='#6a3d9a', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.3, label='1% limit')
ax.set_xlabel('Frequency [Hz]')
ax.set_ylabel('Relative Frobenius error [%]')
ax.set_xlim(8e5, 1.2e9)
ax.set_ylim(0.04, 100)
ax.grid(True, which='both', alpha=0.17)
ax.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.95, fontsize=9)
plt.show()
```
